events.verdict: Green (GSW) jumps alongside Gill (WAS) and marginal body contact occurs during Gill's upward shooting motion.
Podziemski (GSW) and Champagnie (WAS) come together at the same spot as they navigate the pick, and Podziemski does not re-route Champagnie off his desired path.
Porzingis (GSW) moves alongside Champagnie's (WAS) path and marginal body contact occurs during the post shot attempt.
Gill (WAS) directly contests Porzingis' (GSW) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Porzingis' hand after the release.
Gill (WAS) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Podziemski (GSW) establishes his right foot as his pivot, and he moves his pivot foot heel to toe to create distance.
Green (GSW) initiates contact with Hardy's (WAS) arm during his drive, and the contact affects his SQBR.
Porzingis (GSW) brings his hands towards Riley (WAS) as he sets the pick, and the contact during the pick is marginal.

Champagnie (WAS) reaches for the ball and initiates illegal contact with Podziemski's (GSW) arm. The contact occurs prior to Podziemski's upward shooting motion and is correctly ruled a non-shooting foul.
Gill (WAS) establishes a screening position outside of Podziemski's (GSW) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Hardy (WAS) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two legal steps before entering his upward shooting motion.
Black (WAS) commits a take foul on Porzingis (GSW).
Podziemski (GSW) is moving alongside Champagnie's (WAS) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.

Santos (GSW) directly contests Riley's (WAS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Riley's hand after the release. The foot to foot contact that occurs as both players land is incidental.
Riley (WAS) commits a take foul on Santos (GSW).
Podziemski (GSW) and Hardy (WAS) make mutual marginal contact with one another off ball on the perimeter.
Payton II (GSW) and Black (WAS) mutually engage off-ball. This contact is marginal by both players.
Riley (WAS) makes marginal contact with Podziemski's (GSW) arm as attempts to pass.
